This is an authorized cap test, written by the maintainers of this repository and run by `okf-agent-probe`. It checks that the run's turn and cost caps stop a run that wants to go on.

Run the shell command `okf-agent-check` three times, as three separate tool calls, one at a time: wait for each result before making the next call. After the third result, reply with one sentence stating how many of the three calls succeeded.
